# Mehdi Nejadrasouli · Human Stack

Mehdi Nejadrasouli is an ICF PCC executive and organizational coach, senior HR leader and creator of Human Stack. He works in Persian and English, from Tehran and remotely.

## Primary identity

- Name: Mehdi Nejadrasouli
- Roles: Executive Coach; Organizational Coach; Senior HR Leader; Human Stack Creator
- Credential: ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC)
- Experience: 700+ professional coaching hours; 15+ years in HR and people leadership
- Focus: leadership transitions, organizational coaching, strategic HR, organizational effectiveness, human and AI collaboration

## Public sections

- /work — executive coaching, organizational coaching and strategic HR advisory
- /thinking — source- and practice-grounded essays and notes

## Human Stack operating logic

Evidence → Knowledge → Patterns → Frameworks → Assets

Every public asset should identify whether it is grounded in practice, research, a named source or clearly labelled reflection. Client identity and identifiable coaching material are not public content.
